text: how do i get numbers myself because i want to actually feel it
resolution: Superseded by req_1933. The user clarified they don't care whether the numbers come via console or a HUD — they just couldn't READ them because per-frame probe spam ([hb]/[r3d-census]/[ground-pass]) was flooding the terminal. Fixed by silencing that spam (req_1933, sha f030a19ea) so the existing [edit-latency] console lines are readable, rather than building a separate on-screen HUD. No HUD code shipped; reopen if a live in-pane readout is wanted later.
